svg.title: How Red Harness works
svg.desc: 1 Target: a binary you own or are authorized to test. 2 Static evidence from Ghidra or IDA. 3 Optional controlled run in Windows Sandbox. 4 The agent records a claim citing evidence ids, quotes and addresses. 5 The verifier rejects claims without quoted evidence; behaviour claims need a controlled run. 6 The report lists accepted findings with evidence and what was not examined.
